title: Exceptional interval bounds on one selected affine chart
statement: Fix a finite purity setting P [def-pur-conventions], finite-type k-schemes X,Y, a separated finite-type k-morphism f:X→Y, and finite affine chart data C [def-pur-affine-chart-cover]. Select one base index v and one chart index i. Write u:U→X for its open inclusion, d for its embedding dimension, i_U:U→A^d_V for its recorded closed embedding, and W for its recorded open complement. Suppose (W,A^d_V) satisfies HasOpenComplementCondition at P.Coefficient with constant c∈ℕ [def-exc-open-complement-bound]. For any integers a≤b: (i) for every K in the constructible interval [a,b] on Y [def-weil-constructible-intervals], Lu^* Rf!K is constructible in [a-2d,b-2d+c+1]; (ii) for every bounded constructible finite-Tor K on Y with Tor amplitude [a,b] [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], Lu^* Rf!K has Tor amplitude [a-2d,b-2d+c+1], tested against all module sheaves [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. The exceptional functor is the specified transported functor [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. No maxima over charts and no global descent conclusion are asserted.

proof.text: Restrict K to V. Exact open inverse image preserves its constructible interval. For a finite-Tor input it preserves the same Tor interval; bounded constructibility follows by applying its constructible clause to any cohomological interval of K. The level in explicitExceptional_preservation is written hn+1; use P.level_pos to identify P.level with (P.level-1)+1.

Use the constructible-origin witness and the witnessed base-open and affine-chart exceptional comparisons. These identify the restriction along u of Rf!K with the closed exceptional image of the smooth projection exceptional image of K restricted to V. Choose the compactifications used by the specified exceptional construction and use compactification independence to identify them with the lifts. The chart factorization is exactly C.embedding_over; the intermediate open into the pullback is supplied by C.chart_contained. No exceptional preservation is used to construct this comparison.

The affine-space projection is separated and smooth of pure relative dimension d. Apply smooth_exceptional_preservation separately to the constructible and the Tor inputs. It gives [a-2d,b-2d], and for the Tor input also bounded constructibility. Apply closedEtaleTransport_bounds to the chosen embedding, complement and bound c; its first clause gives the constructible interval without any Tor hypothesis, and its second gives the Tor interval. Both resulting intervals are [a-2d,b-2d+c+1]. Transfer along the chart comparison.

theorem chart_local_bounds (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (C : Scheme.PurityAffineChartCover f)
    (v : Fin C.baseCount) (i : Fin (C.chartCount v)) (c : ℕ)
    (hc : @Scheme.HasOpenComplementCondition P.Coefficient _ _ _ _
      (C.complement v i).ι inferInstance (C.complement_quasiCompact v i) c)
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∀ K, constructibleInterval P.coefficients.l P.extension P.level P.level_pos Y a b K →
      constructibleInterval P.coefficients.l P.extension P.level P.level_pos
        (C.chartOpen v i).toScheme
        (a - 2 * (C.embeddingDimension v i : ℤ))
        (b - 2 * (C.embeddingDimension v i : ℤ) + (c : ℤ) + 1)
        ((proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback P.Ring (C.chartOpen v i).ι).obj
          ((P.exceptionalInverseImage f).obj K))) ∧
    (∀ K, finiteTorConstructible P.coefficients.l P.extension P.level P.level_pos Y K →
      Scheme.HasProEtaleTorAmplitude Y P.Ring K a b →
      Scheme.HasProEtaleTorAmplitude (C.chartOpen v i).toScheme P.Ring
        ((proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback P.Ring (C.chartOpen v i).ι).obj
          ((P.exceptionalInverseImage f).obj K))
        (a - 2 * (C.embeddingDimension v i : ℤ))
        (b - 2 * (C.embeddingDimension v i : ℤ) + (c : ℤ) + 1))
